rows.grounds: sva + dehe; locative of one's own body
compound devatā + jīva; accusative object to be placed
optative form of nyas; third person singular active

items.question: How does the practitioner establish the deity-life in the body after elemental purification?
premises: The deity-life is placed in one's own body.
Placement is followed by the next ritual step.
items.inference: After purifying the elements, the practitioner places the deity-life in the body and then proceeds onward.
uncertainties: The exact ritual act following placement is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: In one's own body, the deity-life should be placed; thereafter, the next step follows.
